entities.name: University of Nicosia
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary:
The University of Nicosia (UNIC), established in 2011, stands as the largest private university in Cyprus, with its roots tracing back to the Cyprus College founded in 1965. Located in the capital city of Nicosia, this institution plays a pivotal role in advancing higher education in Southern Europe, particularly in the context of the Mediterranean region. UNIC is recognized for its innovative approach to education, including its notable embrace of technology in learning, which aligns with global trends toward digitalization in higher education.

Over the years, UNIC has significantly contributed to the academic landscape by offering a broad range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs across various fields, including business, law, health sciences, and computer science. In 2020, UNIC became the first university in Europe to offer a fully online medical degree program, demonstrating its commitment to pioneering educational methodologies. The university has also established international partnerships with various institutions worldwide, enhancing its academic offerings and facilitating cross-border educational exchanges.

The legacy of the University of Nicosia extends beyond its immediate educational impact; it has fostered a culture of research and innovation in Cyprus and has been instrumental in shaping the future of higher education in the region. The university's commitment to developing critical thinking and global citizenship among its students has produced a generation of graduates who are well-equipped to address contemporary challenges. As of 2023, UNIC boasts over 12,000 students from more than 70 countries, highlighting its significance as a melting pot of cultures and ideas.
